contracts.name: Pooled example graph
contracts.nodes: Eight examples in one microbatch; accumulation does not enlarge this graph
contracts.edges: Dense Gaussian affinity exp(-||z_i-z_j||^2/(2*tau^2)); self-loops retained
contracts.features: Mean-pooled residual states, one B-by-D matrix per layer
contracts.normalization: Symmetric degree-normalized Laplacian; current C1 fractional power policy
noninvariances: Feature scaling at fixed tau changes affinities
General invertible maps need not preserve Euclidean geometry
contracts.intervention: Change representation coordinates while preserving a specified linear readout, only where this factorization is valid
contracts.intended_task_relationship: Hypothesis: graph geometry reflects useful representation structure; not assumed task semantics
contracts.diagnostic_prediction: Orthogonal transforms preserve distances, affinity spectrum and quadratic energy; scaling need not
contracts.falsifying_control: A noninvariant result outside the declared floating tolerance on a valid orthogonal fixture

contracts.name: Token attention graph
contracts.edges: Head-mean attention, symmetrized, diagonal removed and clamped nonnegative
contracts.features: Residual token states and embedding token states on the same attention graph
contracts.normalization: Combinatorial Dirichlet energy divided by count of positive undirected edges
permitted_transformations: Feature orthogonal transformations with a fixed adjacency
Simultaneous mathematical node/feature permutations with fixed graph correspondence
noninvariances: Node permutation is not a symmetry of an entire causal language model
Detached first-example spectral estimate has no universal eigenpair guarantee
contracts.intervention: Fixed-graph feature transformation; no claim that recomputing model attention preserves adjacency
contracts.intended_task_relationship: The band is a heuristic; measured activity is not evidence of avoiding collapse or preserving language quality
contracts.diagnostic_prediction: Orthogonal fixed-graph feature changes preserve energy; squared hinges retain frozen host definitions
contracts.falsifying_control: Fixed-graph energy differs outside tolerance under a valid orthogonal transform

contracts.name: Neuron co-activation hypergraph
contracts.nodes: MLP feature coordinates in the architecture's actual nonlinear basis
contracts.edges: Batch-token events with incidence equal to activation > 0
contracts.features: Activation matrix with extra vertex-degree scaling in the current objective
contracts.normalization: Existing normalized hypergraph incidence plus existing feature degree scaling
permitted_transformations: Neuron permutations accompanied by readout permutation
noninvariances: Arbitrary rotations do not commute with network nonlinearities
Coordinate ablations are different interventions after a basis change
contracts.intervention: Remove a named coordinate at a specified linear feature/readout boundary; compare predictions under that intervention
contracts.intended_task_relationship: Importance is conditional on representation and intervention; a graph score is not causal task importance
contracts.diagnostic_prediction: Permutations preserve matched quantities; compensated orthogonal linear factorization preserves predictions but may reverse ablation rankings
contracts.falsifying_control: Prediction changes under the exactly compensated linear factorization, or failure to preserve a valid permutation

hypotheses.statement: Some training states may produce a numerically uninformative pooled graph at fixed tau
hypotheses.control: Analytic identical, separated and mixed synthetic point clouds
hypotheses.falsifying_outcome: Observed states remain informative under the declared descriptive measures
hypotheses.scope: One seed, training windows; no causal or generalization inference
hypotheses.next_decision: Only propose a separately versioned graph-construction experiment if diagnostics show a concrete limitation

hypotheses.statement: A useful abstraction must distinguish invariant geometry from coordinate interventions
hypotheses.control: Compensated orthogonal linear feature/readout factors and matched coordinate permutations
hypotheses.falsifying_outcome: The control violates its declared equality outside tolerance or an asserted invariance fails
hypotheses.scope: Finite linear-factorization controls, not entire-transformer symmetries
hypotheses.next_decision: Require matched task controls before advancing a representation-aware pruning claim

hypotheses.statement: Training-time diagnostic trajectories may identify targets for a bounded follow-on experiment
hypotheses.control: Fixed training microbatches reused at all four retained checkpoints
hypotheses.falsifying_outcome: No diagnostically useful limitation or change is observed; preserve that result
hypotheses.scope: Descriptive temporal association, not a controlled spectral-treatment effect
hypotheses.next_decision: Prepare an experiment proposal with controls and costs; never schedule automatically

merit_policy: Separate mathematical correctness, observational relevance, resource cost and task effect; no combined merit score
